question: What is the per-pair compute cost of the cross-cloud spin-solve, and where does the cost sit?
hypothesis: The connectability screen (one shoot) is cheap enough to run on all A×B pairs; the bottleneck is cloud_size², not the solve.
narrative_md: Measured atomic costs of processing one cross-cloud pair on seed 119: a 2-anchor BVP solve is 1.72 ms (~14k/s Pool(24)), the cloud-free 3rd-anchor brightness check 0.84 ms. Per-pair cost is dominated by winding enumeration (3.8 s brute vs 0.13 s targeted). The connectability screen (one shoot) is cheap enough for all A×B pairs; the bottleneck is cloud_size² (number of pairs), not the solve. Pure timing — never reads truth.
